INTERNSHIPS
Data Analyst Intern, Kaveri Retail Analytics, Pune (May 2025 - July 2025, 10 weeks)
- Wrote SQL queries on PostgreSQL to pull weekly sales by store and category for the merchandising team.
- Built dbt models that turned raw order and product tables into a clean sales mart.
- Used ROW_NUMBER and LAG window functions to find repeat customers and days between orders.
- Pushed all model changes through Git branches and pull requests reviewed by my mentor.

PROJECTS
Cricket Stats Warehouse (personal project, 2025)
- Designed a star schema with a match fact table and player, venue and season dimensions.
- Loaded 15 seasons of IPL ball-by-ball data from CSV files into PostgreSQL.
- Built a Metabase dashboard showing strike rate and economy trends by season.

Library Management System (DBMS course project, 2024)
- Built a normalised MySQL database for book issues and returns as part of the DBMS course.

Database Management Systems, Data Warehousing and Mining, Probability and Statistics
dbt Fundamentals (dbt Learn, 2025)

SQL, PostgreSQL, MySQL, dbt, Python (basics), Git, Metabase, BigQuery (sandbox), Excel
